games.title: Neon Velocity: Highway Run
games.description: Run on your mat! Foot step intensity modulates the video playback rate from 0.5x to 2.5x speed while dodging 3D perspective hurdles and collecting power rings.

games.title: Beat Sync: Rhythm Arena
games.description: Floor mat rhythm trainer: synchronize your lane switches, high jumps, and duck slides to the musical timeline within a strict 250ms window.

games.title: Shinobi Path: Forest Trial
games.description: State-driven video clip engine: your floor mat actions dynamically switch between running, leaping, sliding, and obstacle impact video clips.
